content.json: **ASIM ZPA parity workbook** — Dedicated normalized equivalent of `Solutions/Zscaler Private Access (ZPA)/Workbooks/ZscalerZPA.json` at Azure-Sentinel commit `cd455a8cecf3e5e983f9cd08191dca3d211c9fa1`. Every source-telemetry panel uses `_Im_NetworkSession` and filters Zscaler Private Access events. The upstream alert panel retains its Sentinel-derived `SecurityAlert` semantics with a Zscaler/ZPA filter. Panel order, titles, visualizations, rankings, and time semantics are preserved. See `zpa-workbook-parity.json` for field-level mappings and limitations.

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler' and EventProduct has 'Private Access'
| where DvcAction == 'Allow'
| where isnotempty(SrcGeoCountry)
| summarize count() by SrcGeoCountry
content.title: Top Countries

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler' and EventProduct has 'Private Access'
| where isnotempty(DvcAction)
| summarize count() by DvcAction
content.title: Connection status
Events over time

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler' and EventProduct has 'Private Access'
| where DvcAction == 'Allow'
| where isnotempty(SrcIpAddr)
| summarize EventCount = count() by SrcIpAddr
| top 10 by EventCount desc
content.title: Top Source IP

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler' and EventProduct has 'Private Access'
| where EventSubType == 'End'
| extend ZPA = todynamic(AdditionalFields)
| extend CloseReason = coalesce(EventOriginalResultDetails, tostring(ZPA.ConnectionCloseReason))
| where isnotempty(CloseReason)
| summarize Reason = count() by CloseReason
content.title: Connection close reasons

content.query:
_Im_NetworkSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventVendor =~ 'Zscaler' and EventProduct has 'Private Access'
| where isnotempty(DstFQDN)
| summarize url = count() by DstFQDN
content.title: Top urlhostname requests
Top VPN Traffic (per user)
New VPN Users

content.query:
SecurityAlert
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where AlertName has 'Zscaler'
| where AlertName has 'ZPA' or AlertName has 'VPN' or Description has 'Zscaler Private Access'
| extend Severity = AlertSeverity
| extend RuleName = AlertName
| project RuleName, Severity
content.title: Latest Alerts
